body: The page this anchored to is retired (the autopoietic-loop framing is superseded). The construction had resurfaced in build/the-collaboration-method under a "recursively" heading — now stated as the plain fact it is: "gnx will be the first project the gnx init command sets up, running its own core set." The heading is "The method applies to gnx itself". The doubled-gnx flourish is gone from every live page.
